snippet.title: and Roger behind the scenes en
snippet.description:
An interview video “and Roger behind the Scenes - yona” with yona, the creator of “and Roger” is now available.

Why did you decide to create this game?
What were you particular about the artwork and storytelling?
What is necessary for an indie game?

In this video interview, he talks about the background of the production and his thoughts on the game.
Please take a look!

Interviewee: yona 
Cinematography, Editing, and Music: Yasuhiro Nakashima

※Please note a correction regarding the on-screen text from 1:17 to 1:22. The pronoun "she" was mistakenly used. yona identifies as male.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
Title: and Roger 
Platforms: Steam/Nintendo Switch 
Steam store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308870/ 
Languages supported: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish 
Genre: interactive fiction 
Release date: July 24, 2025 
Number of players: 1 
Developer: yona (X: https://x.com/Yona_unltb ) 
Publisher: Kodansha Ltd. 
Rights: @Tearyhand Studio / Kodansha Ltd.
